connector.name: Enigmagent MCP
connector.registryDescription: Local AES-256-GCM vault for AI agents. Secrets stay local, LLMs never see real API keys.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package enigmagent-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the agnuxo1 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VAULT_PASSWORD
env.description: Master password used to decrypt the local EnigmAgent vault (AES-256-GCM + Argon2id).
